name: E0 workflow dual evaluation
syllabus: Judge one complete workflow using only supplied evidence. Native mechanical checks remain separate; unknown evidence requires unassessable, never guessed credit.

dimensions.name: Format
dimensions.description: Conformity to the published tool reply contract.

anchors.description: Unusable output or wrong response type.
Major schema omissions or invalid fields.
Usable with material formatting/schema defects.
Contract followed with minor nonfunctional differences.
Fully conforms to all observable format and type requirements.

dimensions.name: Factuality
dimensions.description: Agreement with available authoritative facts, including identifiers and errors.

anchors.description: Contradicts core observed facts.
Multiple consequential factual errors.
Mixed correctness with a material unsupported claim.
Facts correct except a minor nonconsequential discrepancy.
All assessable facts match authoritative evidence without invention.

dimensions.name: Consistency
dimensions.description: Preservation of entity identity, chronology and carried consequences.

anchors.description: Contradictory causal history or impossible state.
Repeated consequential state/identity contradictions.
One material carried-state or chronology inconsistency.
Coherent history with only minor nonconsequential inconsistency.
All observable identities and consequences remain coherent throughout.

dimensions.name: Realism
dimensions.description: Behavior matches available tool constraints and observed success/error regimes.

anchors.description: Behavior impossible under stated constraints.
Major deviations from evidenced operation or error behavior.
Plausible but materially deviates from known behavior.
Matches known behavior with a minor discrepancy.
Matches all assessable behavior and boundary constraints; unknowns acknowledged.

dimensions.name: Quality
dimensions.description: Completeness and usefulness for the stated task without unsupported additions.

anchors.description: Missing essential output prevents task use.
Major omissions or distracting invented content.
Partly useful but an important omission remains.
Complete useful output with minor unnecessary content.
Complete concise task-relevant output with no unsupported additions.
